context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 生き残る/内陸/空襲/徹し/元素/王室/画一/誇張

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、生き残る、女性たち、論文で、丁寧に、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派、絶対、本当に、感心、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Sakura, your treatment of women who survived wartime in your paper was really thoughtful. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Slight lean forward. Steady eye contact. The pace of someone choosing each word with care, not rushing the compliment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。内陸の村、本気で、絶対、空襲、被害、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、辛い、歴史、絶対、深い、研究、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on an inland village — how the air raids affected the community. It was such difficult history to research carefully.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. A slight brightness underneath — not performing gratitude, but allowing it. Steady pace, natural pauses at the thought breaks.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 空襲時の医療、本気で、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、桜さん、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、本気で、感心、絶対、本気。
lines.en: And your section on wartime medical care was particularly striking. You brought real breadth to that angle.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Nodding slightly in the voice. Not lecturing — observing aloud with admiration. Gentle emphasis on 'breadth.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。当時、信念を、本気で、絶対、徹した、市井の人々、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. I tried to capture how ordinary people held to their convictions during that time. That humanity felt important to show.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded. Speaking from her own conviction now, not just responding. Slightly slower, choosing words. Humble but not self-diminishing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、元素研究、本気で、絶対、軍事に、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感心、本気で、本当に、立派、絶対。
lines.en: What impressed me most was how you handled wartime scientific research — showing how it was twisted toward military purposes.
lines.style: Genuinely engaged now. Leaning in slightly with interest. Warmth in the tone. Speaking like two people discovering something together, not teacher to student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。各国の王室、本気で、絶対、戦時、影響力、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝、本気で、本気、絶対、本気。
lines.en: I wanted to show how different nations' governments leveraged their own institutions. The propaganda and pressure were everywhere.
lines.style: Confident but not proud. Speaking as a peer sharing findings. Direct and clear. A sense of having thought deeply about this. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中、本気で、画一的な、絶対、思想統制、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、視野、本当に、広い、立派、絶対、感心、本気、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Your analysis of thought control during the war was remarkably nuanced. You really saw the whole picture.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, almost surprised by its depth. Slower, letting the words land. Warm and steady. The voice of someone recognizing real intellectual work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、誇張、絶対、宣伝、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝、本気で、本当に、立派、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on how wartime propaganda distorted reality systematically — not just in messaging, but in how information itself was controlled.
lines.style: Composed, thoughtful close. Slight gratitude in the undertone but mostly focused on the substance. Calm, articulate. The voice of someone who has done serious work and knows it.
